verdict.rationale: Rootly documents several in-product AI features grounded in the user's own incident data. These include AI Summaries generated from metadata, alerts and timeline, and an Ask Rootly AI chat on the incident page. AI SRE delivers a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps, alongside related-incident matching and AI-drafted retrospective blocks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality (all evidence is vendor docs; community items don't address the AI features).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI Summaries writes it for you, from what the incident already knows: metadata, alerts, timeline events, action items, and (when permitted) Slack messages and meeting transcripts.
Rootly AI in Web is an AI chat built into the incident page of the Rootly web app. Open it on any incident and ask questions in natural language.
Answers are grounded in that incident's live context: its timeline, alerts, chat history, and bridge-call transcripts.
Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and gives responders a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps.
Rootly AI matches your incident against everything your team already solved.
an AI block is a section, such as What Happened or Contributing Factors, that Rootly AI drafts for you from the incident's own context.
